ns2:course.label: Physical Activity Research Methods
ns2:course.description: This course provides an introduction of physical activity measurement and methods. The course will focus on (a) defining physical activity and associated terms and concepts; (b) providing detailed understanding of approaches and tools for measuring physical activity; and (c) facilitating understanding of scientific methods for physical activity research (e.g., experimental and non-experimental designs).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lecture and one laboratory section.
